outcome.technical: drive-phase.py: on the writer path (writer_path_on) gate_step no longer runs the task gate inside next. background_gate prints dispatch-gate (rule WRITER_RULE, its run: line `python3 run-test-gate.py <manifest> <phase> --task <id> --record --project-dir <project> [--tree] [--no-reuse]`, paths absolute, spelled by the new gate_args that record_gate also uses) and marks the launch (gateLaunched: moment, argv, the task's ledger runIds then). A next with no new task row prints wait-gate with the same run: line; a new `cancelled` row (gate stopped mid-run) launches it again; a new passed/failed row is repeated through record_gate (GATE VERDICT REUSED on the same content; a did-line says so if it measured instead); any other status is decided from as recorded through a drive-minted red text carrying `evidence: recorded <runId>` so the existing row readers find it. New STEPS dispatch-gate/wait-gate with SIGNAL_VERBS dispatch/wait; gate_red_decision's why skips the repeat banner line. Module docstring, PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md (new paragraph in the drive-phase.py section) and orchestrator.md (lines 15-18 reworded; the background-gate paragraph tightened to make room: 61946/62000) updated. tests/test_drive_phase.py: new bg-block (bg1-bg5), corpus entries for both steps (sn1), `_signal_next` now plays a printed gate dispatch (only run-test-gate commands, never a session) via `_signal_steps`; rv7, xs4 and bm1 now read past repeat rows. Gate `sweep-selftests.py tests/test_drive_phase.py tests/test__refs.py tools/_suite.py` exit 0 (3/3 files ok, 1186 cases); measure-context --gate exit 0; test__output_lints 182/182, test__deps 284/284, test__worktrees 182/182, test__filed_returns 118/118, test__invariants 141/141, test_audit_status 411/411, test_commit_task_work 239/239, test_detect_plan_skip 46/46, each exit 0; ruff and vermin exit 0. Dependants: _worktrees.py and every listed importer still correct - record_gate's arguments for its callers are unchanged (the absolute spelling is only on the printed command) and the gate step changes only under executor.writerModel; the suites above are green. PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md and orchestrator.md dependants (CHANGELOG, measure-context, _refs) unaffected: orchestrator.md stays under its ceiling. Left open: the Agent path still gates inside next; so do the base measurement a red asks for (measure_base, a whole gate at the base), follow_red_gate's re-gate after a recipe, and the phase sign-off gate - the same CLI-kill class. A wave print carries only first lines, so a gate member's WRITER_RULE is not printed in a wave. The non-repeatable non-cancelled arm (no-checks/timed-out/cannot-run/gate-mutated) has no case of its own. FOREGROUND_BOUND_MS was not needed: the dispatch is unconditional on the writer path, which costs a fast gate one more orchestrator turn; a mean-based condition would need that constant moved out of audit-lookup.py (an entry point drive-phase.py may not import) into a lower module such as _evidence_io.py. Prose outside my files: plugins/audit/reference/execute-task.md:265 says only that a red goes back to the session, not that the gate is a background dispatch (incomplete, not false); commands/{next,run,resume,review,phase}.md already route a writer-path dispatch's run: line to background Bash (bg5 holds it). Incident: drafting bg3g against the unfixed driver, my helper ran the reviewer-session run: line it printed with no stub on PATH, which started the real `claude` (--max-budget-usd 2.5) in a fixture temp dir for about two minutes; I killed it (pid 12191) and _play_gate now refuses any command that is not run-test-gate.py.
